items.headline: Long-dormant coins are waking up
items.detail: Liveliness 0.620 is 4.1σ up vs its month. Rising = old coins moving (distribution/rotation); falling = holders sitting still (accumulation).
items.framing: Older coins are starting to move — liveliness ticked up. Interesting "the patient money is stirring" angle; not a direction call.

items.headline: Holders ~26% underwater — and still not selling
items.detail: MVRV 0.74: price is 26% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.506). Yet 57% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving.
items.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
items.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 15th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 57 while the rest average 21 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 57/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: SPX's MVRV 0.73 = 2th percentile of Bitcoin's history
items.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.73 sits at the 2th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
items.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 2th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
items.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.

items.headline: NUPL -0.36 — capitulation
items.detail: Net unrealised profit/loss is -0.36 (from MVRV 0.73) — the market sits in the capitulation zone.
items.framing: Aggregate holder profitability. Below zero = the crowd is underwater, historically an accumulation zone.
items.note: A position read, not a signal.

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
items.detail: Of 27,009 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,358 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-16.2% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 6.86M SPX. 4w -14.4% · 12w -16.2% · 26w -23.6%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-16.2% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.
